# Willow Grove SDA Church
> A welcoming Seventh-day Adventist church in Willow Grove, PA. Worship Saturdays at 11:00 AM, 1576 Fairview Ave, Willow Grove, PA 19090. Phone (215) 657-8364.

## Pages
- [Willow Grove SDA Church — Come Worship. Grow in Christ.](https://willowgrovesdachurch.org/): Worship with us Saturdays at 11:00 AM at 1576 Fairview Ave, Willow Grove, PA. A Christ-centered, Bible-based Seventh-day Adventist church family.
- [Plan a Visit — Willow Grove SDA Church](https://willowgrovesdachurch.org/visit/): Everything you need for your first visit: service time, location, parking, what to wear, and what to expect at Willow Grove SDA Church.
- [About — Willow Grove SDA Church](https://willowgrovesdachurch.org/about/): Who we are, what we believe, and the story of Willow Grove Seventh-day Adventist Church.
- [Ministries — Willow Grove SDA Church](https://willowgrovesdachurch.org/ministries/): Feeding ministry, prison ministry, Pathfinders, Sabbath School, and young adults — find where you belong at Willow Grove SDA Church.
- [Events — Willow Grove SDA Church](https://willowgrovesdachurch.org/events/): Upcoming events and recurring gatherings at Willow Grove SDA Church.
- [Watch — Willow Grove SDA Church](https://willowgrovesdachurch.org/watch/): Watch Willow Grove SDA Church services and recent sermons online.
- [Give — Willow Grove SDA Church](https://willowgrovesdachurch.org/give/): Support the mission of Willow Grove SDA Church with a secure online gift through Adventist Giving.
- [Contact — Willow Grove SDA Church](https://willowgrovesdachurch.org/contact/): Contact Willow Grove SDA Church: address, phone, directions, and a message form.
